استنجبت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَبْتُ (istanjabtu) /is.tan.d͡ʒab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجَبْتَ (istanjabta) /is.tan.d͡ʒab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجَبْتِ (istanjabti) /is.tan.d͡ʒab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجَبَتْ (istanjabat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
